text: Si lorra ñawnu maa alhaali bonɗo memii noɗɗanke fantinɗo, o noddira Men yankinaare hara himo waalorii senngo makko, maa hara himo jooɗii, maa hara himo darii. O noddira Men jortagol nde lorra makko kan iwata. Tuma nde Men jaabii mo toraare makko nden, Men ittani mo ngun ñawu yanungu e makko, o heɓaano ko o waɗa si wanaa yawtirgol wa si tawii o noddaano Men e huncangol mo on lorra makka. Ko wano oo ɗuurniiɗo ɗoo suɗiranaa non majjere makko nden, yawtuɓe keeri Alla ɓen kadi cuɗiranaa keeferaaku maɓɓe ngu ɓe laatinoo e mun, ɓe accatah ngun.
